questions.grading_note: Any equivalent form. 8/10 = 12/EF, so EF = 15.

questions.standard_level: Geometry. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Geometry, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.prompt: Triangle PQR ~ triangle STU, with PQ = 5, ST = 15, QR = x + 2, and TU = 2x + 9. What is x?
questions.prompt_markup:
Triangle PQR ~ triangle STU, with PQ = 5, ST = 15, QR = x + 2, and TU = 2x + 9.
What is x?
questions.grading_note: The scale factor is 3, so 3(x + 2) = 2x + 9 and x = 3 (QR = 5, TU = 15).
